scope: Selected audit of effective ISO 32000-2:2020(E) §§8.6.5.6, 8.6.5.7, 8.6.5.9 and 8.6.7, including sampled EC3 changes. This does not certify all colour conversion, output-device separation, or transparency behavior.

source.locator_basis: Primary-PDF footer pages, not markdown image/page numbering.

errata.location: Inline-image NOTE 3, printed p.270 / physical p.285
errata.effect: Device colour operator names identify the device space directly or via default colour space. Confirms that the default lookup applies to these names; it does not change the default-space clauses themselves.

Deletes the table's stated default sentence for UseBlackPtComp. Section 8.6.5.9 already leaves absent or Default behavior to the processor, so the implementation's chosen default remains a reader choice.
Strikes text excusing support for every rendering intent. The four standard names remain AbsoluteColorimetric, RelativeColorimetric, Saturation, and Perceptual.

features.title: Default colour spaces
requirements_sampled: Whenever a device Gray, RGB, or CMYK space is selected for a painting operation, resources in force are checked for its corresponding DefaultGray, DefaultRGB, or DefaultCMYK; if present the default is used.

Source component values pass unchanged, with equal component count, and are clamped to the destination range. The default must not be Lab, Indexed, or Pattern; compatibility is recommended rather than a general reader rejection requirement.
The lookup also applies to an underlying device space of Pattern, Indexed base, Separation alternate, or DeviceN alternate when that alternate is actually selected. No tint conversion is introduced.
features.ledger_feature_coverage: The note maps named and array/device paths, nested special-space routes, image/inline/shading routes, initial values and press-group use. It explicitly separates malformed default producer constraints from reader behavior.
features.verdict: Sampled valid-route behavior has discriminating consumer evidence, including nested-resource positive controls, images, inline images, shading, array/name forms, and selected special-space paths. No additional defect identified in this shard.
residuals: Not every alternate family and paint operator was independently exercised here; that is not evidence of a default-space defect.
The clause's invalid-default type restrictions are writer constraints; no malformed-input reader rejection is demanded by this review.

features.title: Implicit conversion of CIE-Based colour spaces
requirements_sampled: A processor should avoid conversion when a CIE-based source accurately represents the particular output device; PDF does not encode the calibration conditions that would let a reader decide this generally.

If implicit conversion is performed, device-space semantics also apply, including nonzero overprint mode and device-colour conversions into a group space. The source may be direct ICCBased or reached through a default colour space.
features.verdict: The implementation preserves same-profile press values in press-group contexts and carries device overprint semantics into those paths. Outside such a group, the general matching-device recommendation is a SHOULD with conditions the source says cannot be specified in PDF; declining a universal shortcut is an implementation policy rather than a demonstrated conformance failure.
residuals: This sampled set does not independently exercise every CIE-based family through every route, nor establish a general output-device calibration policy.

features.title: Use of black point compensation
requirements_sampled: UseBlackPtComp ON uses ISO 18619; OFF disables compensation; absent or Default is left to the processor.
For an object whose current intent is AbsoluteColorimetric, UseBlackPtComp is treated as OFF. Intent and BPC are separate state inputs combined per painted object.
features.verdict: The source-defined standard spelling AbsoluteColorimetric is used in distinct ON/OFF/Default and intent-ordering tests. Controlled synthetic ICC routes and per-object absolute-intent precedence are covered. No BPC behavior defect identified.
residuals: §8.6.5.9 prose spells the intent AbsColorimetric while Table 69 and the tested PDF name use AbsoluteColorimetric. Keep this as a source terminology/citation discrepancy; do not demand an unregistered alias absent evidence EC3 resolves it.
The Default choice is the processor's discretion and is documented as this implementation's policy, not a normative universal default.

features.title: Overprint control (opaque imaging model only in this feature entry)
requirements_sampled: OP/op control whether unspecified output colourants are erased; OPM affects only a current-colour DeviceCMYK operation (including implicit DeviceCMYK conversion), and only when overprint is true.
OPM 1 preserves prior values for zero CMYK components; the zero decision is made on PDF values before quantization.

The clause explicitly excludes images and shadings from OPM and excludes OPM when the native output space lacks CMYK colourants. Transparent-model compatible overprint is separately addressed in §11.7.4.
features.verdict: Current direct-fill, mode, device-capability, and spot-image paths have meaningful controls. The sampled public tests do not isolate the explicit sampled-DeviceCMYK-image exclusion from the direct current-colour OPM1 rule.
residuals: A new draft compares a DeviceCMYK sampled image under OPM1 with the same image under ordinary state and with a direct DeviceCMYK OPM1 fill. It is unexecuted; see drafts/cmyk_sampled_image_ignores_opm.rs.
This does not re-audit §11.7.4 transparent-group behavior, covered by a separate shard.
